tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card. Also the fill inside inputs and selects.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header and nav bars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, button fills, the newest coach line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, row dividers, the nav underline track. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and buttons on hover. Holds 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, timestamps, hints, placeholders, inactive tabs. Passes 4.5:1 on ground, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and decorative marks only. Below 4.5:1, so never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The brand amber and the coach's voice. Fill for the primary button, active tab underline, live indicators. Put on-signal text on it.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill. 8:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text: the coach label, links, warn pills. Passes 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the line the coach is speaking right now, and behind a warn pill.

tokens.name: team-us
tokens.usage: Your team: your score, your alive count, your questions in the feed. Text-safe on ground and surface.

tokens.name: team-them
tokens.usage: The enemy team: their score and alive count only. Text-safe on ground and surface. Blue against orange so the sides read for colour-blind players.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Healthy status: capture running, push-to-talk ready, a win. Always beside a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors and losses. Always beside a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset. 4.8:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page and report titles. Set at width 85 (font-variation-settings "wdth" 85) for the condensed broadcast cut.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings in reports and settings. Width 90.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Card titles, table headers, phase tags, in ink-muted, sentence case. Width 100.

styles.name: coach-line
styles.sample: 3 v 2. They have to come to you.
styles.usage: What the coach said, in the feed. The most-read text in the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reinforce the main wall and the hatch above it.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Refreshes every 3 seconds while this tab is open.
styles.usage: Hints and helper text, in ink-muted.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Timer, alive counts, cost: any number that changes live.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Timestamps in the feed, raw JSON in the screen-read view.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group, feed row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Report margins, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Phase tags, table cells that highlight.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the frame image.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills and slider thumbs.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Borders separate surfaces; the one shadow is for menus that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dropdowns and the datalist menu only.
